_about: The sound of a PLACE, under every film shot there: one looping bed per set (engine/sound.mjs adds it when tools/film.sh renders with --set). A file, or an Openverse query (CC0 / CC-BY, credited in assets/sfx/credits.json like every found sound). Kept out of library/sets/ on purpose: a set file is part of the render stamp, a sound is not, so changing a bed never re-renders a frame.

edo-village.why: a moonlit street: insects and night air under the lanterns

ganryujima-beach.why: the strait: waves on the sand
